title: Private Min Pack — Alert Noise Review Sheet
content:
Private Min Pack — Alert Noise Review Sheet
Owner: Sean Gallagher (SRE)   Primary editor: Sergio Costa (rules)   Last sweep: 2025-03-08

Purpose
- Track proposed min-pack alerts, expected fire rates, what we saw in staging / early customer beta, and decisions to reduce noise.
- Target outcome: default-on pack has low false positives; warning/capacity signals are non-paging and traffic-gated.

Environments referenced
- Staging ref env: "private-vpc-ref-02" (synthetic load + upgrade drills), 2025-02-20 → 2025-03-02
- Beta (prod-like): "cust-beta-aurora" (customer-operated VPC), 2025-03-01 → 2025-03-07 (read-only access to alert history via customer screenshots + exported Alertmanager history)

Severity definitions (min pack defaults)
- sev1 = page (customer on-call or Redwood-managed depending on contract)
- sev2 = ticket/urgent (no page by default)
- sev3 = warning/info

Legend for key columns
- Traffic gate: guard clause to avoid low-traffic quantile weirdness (default: requests > 1 rps sustained over window)
- Expected fire rate: what we believe is acceptable in a healthy cluster
- Observed: what actually happened (include count + why)

TAB: RULES (current + review notes)
Columns:
Alert | Group | Default sev | Summary | Default for | Traffic gate | Expected fire rate | Observed (staging) | Observed (beta) | Noise / root cause | Decision | Change requested (link) | Owner | Last reviewed

PrivateInferenceAvailabilityBurnRateFast | slo-burn | sev1 | Multi-window burn on gateway 5xx/upstream failures vs 99.9% SLO | 0m (multi-window) | Yes (>=1 rps) | ~0 in healthy; should only fire on real outages | 1 fire (12m) during runtime crashloop drill; actioned correctly | 0 fires | None. Did what we wanted. | KEEP as-is (default-on) | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Sean Gallagher | 2025-03-05
PrivateInferenceAvailabilityBurnRateSlow | slo-burn | sev2 | Slow burn indicator for sustained elevated 5xx | 0m (multi-window) | Yes (>=1 rps) | 0–1/month healthy | 2 fires: (1) intentional chaos test; (2) false positive during low traffic window when rps hovered 0.8–1.2 and error spikes from 1–2 reqs | 1 fire (false-ish): customer had maintenance window + low traffic; got a sev2 ticket; acceptable | Low-traffic sample size. Gate too close to threshold. | ADJUST gating: require >=5 rpm AND >=200 req/30m (if metric exists); otherwise bump gate to 2 rps | Linear:ENG-2860 note; follow-up in GitHub:observability-pack#322 (amend) | Sergio Costa | 2025-03-06
PrivateGatewayNoReadyPods | availability-hard-down | sev1 | Gateway has zero ready pods / endpoints | 5m | No | ~0 | 0 | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Sergio Costa | 2025-03-01
PrivateRuntimeAllShardsUnavailable | availability-hard-down | sev1 | Runtime ready but all shards unavailable / scheduler reports 0 capacity | 5m | No | ~0 | 1 fire during intentional GPU drain test; correct | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Omar El-Sayed | 2025-03-02
PrivateControlPlaneCriticalDown | availability-hard-down | sev2 | Control plane component down when it blocks serving (policy/auth/config store) | 10m | No | ~0 | 0 | 0 | None | KEEP (sev2 default; let customer route) | GitHub:observability-pack#324 | Ethan Park | 2025-03-03
PrivateGateway5xxRateHigh | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | 5xx > 1% over 15m (non-SLO) | 15m | Yes (>=1 rps) | Rare; ideally 0 | 3 fires: 2 were real (bad runtime image), 1 false from canary w/ 30 reqs total | 0 | Low sample size on canary. | Add min-requests gate: >=500 req/15m (or >=2 rps) | Linear:ENG-2860; patch planned in GitHub:observability-pack#322 follow-up | Nadia Rahman | 2025-03-06
PrivateGatewayUpstreamErrorRateHigh | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | Upstream errors (timeouts/reset) > 0.5% for 15m | 15m | Yes | Rare | 4 fires; 2 corresponded to intentional network impairment; 2 corresponded to load generator timeouts (client-side) but surfaced as upstream reset | 1 fire (customer had LB idle timeout mismatch) -> useful | Some errors were client misconfig; still actionable but noisy on staging. | KEEP threshold, but add annotation: "check LB timeouts / client"; keep sev2 | GitHub:observability-pack#319 notes + follow-up | Markus Klein | 2025-03-05
PrivateGatewayRequestLatencyP95High | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | p95 request latency > 7.5s for 30m | 30m | Yes | Possibly 0–2/week depending on workload; should not page | 6 fires; all during low/moderate traffic with long context prompts; not actionable without workload context | 2 fires; customer running very long ctx and expected high latency | Default threshold too generic; causes “expected behavior” alerts. | CHANGE DEFAULT: disable by default OR ship as sev3; require explicit opt-in flag `alerts.latency.enabled=true` | Linear:ENG-2860; propose values.yaml toggle in GitHub:redwood-helm-charts#513 | Sean Gallagher | 2025-03-07
PrivateGatewayTTFTP95High | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | p95 TTFT > 3.5s for 30m | 30m | Yes | Similar to above | 5 fires; same root cause as latency | 1 fire | Same as above. | Same decision as above (opt-in) | Linear:ENG-2860 | Allison Grant | 2025-03-07
PrivateStreamingDisconnectRateHigh | latency-and-queueing | sev3 | Streaming disconnects > 0.5% over 30m | 30m | Yes | Low but non-zero in real world | 9 fires; mostly load generator closing connections early; noisy | 1 fire (customer had proxy buffering issue) -> useful | Synthetic load doesn’t represent real streaming. | KEEP but set default sev3 + require min sessions >=1000/30m; add runbook note re client/proxy | GitHub:observability-pack#319 follow-up | Logan Wright | 2025-03-06
PrivateSchedulerQueueDepthHigh | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | Queue depth above safe watermark for 15m | 15m | Yes | Rare unless underprovisioned | 2 fires during mis-sized GPU pool test; correct | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#320 | Julian Moore | 2025-03-02
PrivateRuntimeQueueTimeP95High | latency-and-queueing | sev2 | Runtime queue time p95 elevated for 30m | 30m | Yes | Should correlate with saturation | 3 fires; correlated with GPU memory pressure; useful | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#320 | Omar El-Sayed | 2025-03-02
PrivateGPUMemoryUtilizationHigh | resource-saturation | sev2 | GPU mem > 95% for 10m | 10m | No (but correlate) | Occasional (burst) but should be rare | 7 fires; 5 were “normal” (model swap warmup); 2 real (OOM imminent) | 2 fires; both preceded OOM by ~8m (good) | Warmup spikes create noise. | Add `for: 20m` AND gate on `rps >= 1` OR “oom events >0”; keep sev2 | Linear:ENG-2860; change in GitHub:observability-pack#321 follow-up | Sergio Costa | 2025-03-06
PrivateGPUOOMEvents | resource-saturation | sev2 | Any OOM events > 0 in 15m | 0m | Yes | 0 in healthy | 1 fire during intentional OOM test; correct | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#321 | Omar El-Sayed | 2025-03-02
PrivateGPUComputeUtilizationHigh | resource-saturation | sev3 | GPU util > 95% for 30m (capacity planning) | 30m | Yes | Can be frequent in well-utilized clusters | 18 fires; too chatty in staging where we kept load high | N/A (customer disabled sev3 routing) | sev3 is fine, but default-on creates “always firing” banners in Alertmanager UI | DEFAULT OFF for sev3 capacity signals OR ship but disabled in values.yaml `alerts.capacity.enabled=false` | Proposed in GitHub:redwood-helm-charts#513 | Sean Gallagher | 2025-03-07
PrivateNodeMemoryAvailableLow | resource-saturation | sev2 | Node memory available < 10% for 15m | 15m | No | Rare | 0 | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Nadia Rahman | 2025-03-01
PrivatePodOOMKills | resource-saturation | sev2 | Any OOMKill > 0 in 15m | 0m | No | ~0 | 0 | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Sergio Costa | 2025-03-01
PrivateNodeFilesystemUsageHigh | resource-saturation | sev2 | Disk usage > 85% for 30m | 30m | No | Occasional | 2 fires due to Prometheus TSDB growth on small staging disk; useful | 1 fire (customer sized disk too small) -> useful | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Bruno Silva | 2025-03-03
PrivateNodeFilesystemUsageCritical | resource-saturation | sev1 | Disk usage > 95% for 10m (risk write failure) | 10m | No | ~0 | 0 | 0 | None | KEEP (but ensure routes don’t page in staging by default) | Values doc note | Connor O'Brien | 2025-03-06
PrivatePrometheusScrapeTargetsDownCore | pipeline-health | sev2 | >10% of core scrape targets down for 10m | 10m | No | Rare; should indicate real break | 5 fires during upgrade drill where ServiceMonitor labels changed; caught real issue | 1 fire (customer rotated cert and blocked scrape) -> useful | None (high-signal) | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#323 | Sahana Iyer | 2025-03-04
PrivatePrometheusRuleLoadFailure | pipeline-health | sev1 (prod) / sev2 (non-prod) | Rule group load/eval errors for 5m | 5m | No | ~0 | 1 fire during incident drill (promtool parse error) -> desired | 0 | None | KEEP; confirm env label exists for severity split (otherwise default sev2) | Linear:ENG-2843; GitHub:observability-pack#322 | Allison Grant | 2025-03-04
PrivateMissingSignalsRequiredMetrics | missing-signals | sev2 | Required metrics absent (dashboards/SLO) | 15m | No | ~0 | 12 fires in staging after scaling to zero on canary namespaces; too sensitive | 0 | absent() triggers when workload intentionally absent (optional components) | Split into (A) core-required (gateway/runtime) default-on, (B) optional components default-off; add namespace allowlist | Linear:ENG-2860; follow-up in GitHub:observability-pack#323 | Nadia Rahman | 2025-03-07
PrivateMissingRequiredLabels | missing-signals | sev2 | Required labels missing (tenant/model/route) for key series | 30m | Yes | ~0 | 2 fires after rolling back runtime; found regression quickly | 0 | None | KEEP | GitHub:redwood#28741 | Nadia Rahman | 2025-03-03
PrivateLogCollectorDroppedRecords | pipeline-health | sev2 | Collector drops > 0 for 10m (with volume) | 10m | Yes (min records) | Rare | 8 fires; 6 due to aggressive debug logs in staging; 2 real (buffer too small) | 1 fire (customer SIEM endpoint throttling) -> useful | Too sensitive when log volume high; no suppression for known debug spikes | Add min drop-rate threshold: >0.1% AND min volume >= 10k/10m; add guidance: reduce debug logs | GitHub:observability-pack#323 | Kevin Osei | 2025-03-06
PrivateLogExportFailures | pipeline-health | sev2 | Export failures non-zero for 10m | 10m | No | Rare | 1 fire during intentional SIEM endpoint cut; correct | 2 fires (customer SIEM TLS issues) -> useful | None | KEEP | GitHub:observability-pack#323 | Kevin Osei | 2025-03-06

TAB: DECISIONS SUMMARY (what changed vs original proposal)
Decision ID | Area | Decision | Rationale | Default behavior | Owner | Target PR
D-01 | Latency alerts | Make p95 latency + TTFT alerts opt-in (or downgrade to sev3) | Too workload/model dependent; noisy in staging and beta; better as dashboards + manual SLO opt-in | `alerts.latency.enabled=false` by default; dashboards still shipped | Sean Gallagher | GitHub:redwood-helm-charts#513
D-02 | Burn-rate slow | Strengthen traffic gating / min samples | False positives when volume is tiny; burn math not meaningful | Increase gate to >=2 rps or add min req count where available | Sergio Costa | GitHub:observability-pack#322 (amend)
D-03 | Capacity sev3 | Disable capacity-planning alerts by default | They are “always true” in healthy, well-utilized clusters; clutter in Alertmanager | `alerts.capacity.enabled=false` by default | Allison Grant | GitHub:redwood-helm-charts#513
D-04 | GPU mem high | Increase `for:` and/or gate on rps/oom | Warmup spikes created noise; still want pre-OOM signal | `for: 20m` and/or require rps>=1; keep sev2 | Sergio Costa | GitHub:observability-pack#321 (follow-up)
D-05 | Missing signals | Split core vs optional missing-series checks | absent() is too aggressive for optional components; staging had intentional scale-to-zero | Core checks default-on; optional checks default-off; namespace allowlist | Nadia Rahman | GitHub:observability-pack#323 (follow-up)
D-06 | Log drops | Use rate-based threshold + min volume | Non-actionable blips during debug logging; keep for compliance pipelines | drop_rate > 0.1% and volume gate | Kevin Osei | GitHub:observability-pack#323 (follow-up)

TAB: NOTES / OPEN ITEMS
- Need explicit `environment` label in alert series for "sev1 in prod / sev2 otherwise" behavior.
  - If not guaranteed, ship as sev2 and let routing upgrade to page.
  - Owner: Nadia Rahman. Tracking: Linear:ENG-2845.

- Staging noise theme: low sample sizes + synthetic load patterns (disconnects, client timeouts).
  - Action: update load generator config in validation harness to keep streaming sessions open and use realistic ctx distribution.
  - Owner: Leila Farouk. Tracking: Linear:ENG-2847.

- Customer beta feedback (Aurora): they mostly cared about:
  - "Are we down?" (gateway/runtime hard down)
  - "Why did 5xx spike?" (burn + upstream errors)
  - "Are we blind?" (scrape/rule load)
  - They explicitly asked to avoid paging on latency until after baseline established.
  - Source: Markus Klein notes from weekly sync (2025-03-07).

- Runbook coverage gaps found during drills:
  - Need runbook section: "LB idle timeouts / proxy buffering causing upstream errors + stream disconnects".
  - Owner: Kira Thompson / Elliot Price. Tracking: Linear:ENG-2848.

- Release gating suggestion (SRE): before GA, run 48h in staging with:
  - Alertmanager history export shows < 3 sev2/day average (excluding intentional drills)
  - 0 sev1 except for drills
  - Pipeline-health alerts must fire when we intentionally break scraping/rule load

Change log
- 2025-03-08: Added D-05/D-06 decisions after log drop + missing signals review.
- 2025-03-07: Proposed opt-in latency alerts (D-01), capacity default-off (D-03).
- 2025-03-05: Initial sheet populated from rules bundle + staging history.
